title: Station Message
description: One message in a station's thread (MET-A-029). A message never carries the identity of the steward who wrote it: a steward message comes from the station. No other fields are allowed.

id.description: Set by the server. A higher id was received later, and a thread's messages are ordered by it.

clientMessageId.description: The UUID the writing client generated. A client uses it to recognise its own pending message. It is random, says nothing about the writer and is never written to the incident log.

activationId.description: The activation the thread belongs to.

station.description: The station the thread belongs to, the same value as station in a position report.

sender.description: STATION: written by a steward checked in at the station. CONTROL_ROOM: written by an operator. Set by the server from the role in the token.

text.description: Free text. Plain text, never HTML or markup.

writtenAt.description: When the message was written, from the writing device's clock. Kept as sent, also for a message delivered late from an offline queue. Shown to users, but never used for ordering or for the thread state, because the device's clock is not trusted.

receivedAt.description: When the server received the message. Set by the server.
